raw_macaulay_dimension_obstruction.interpretation: Surjectivity in shifted homogeneous degree D is impossible while the source dimension is smaller than the target dimension. Hence an irrelevant-power/module-surjectivity certificate from these generators cannot start below the listed first dimensionally possible degree.
raw_macaulay_dimension_obstruction.scope: This is a necessary dimension bound, not a proof of surjectivity at the first possible degree.

degree4_pure_term_obstruction.full_p3_fact: A separately replayed historical certificate proves that the exact 10767 by 10767 non-pure-coordinate minor of the full P3 contraction space has rank 10767 over F_89. This verifier imports that hash-bound fact rather than rebuilding the 563 MB full matrix.
degree4_pure_term_obstruction.conclusion: No nonzero constant linear combination of any of the r43, r64, or r412 augmented rows is supported only on pure shifted module monomials. Thus the absolute least shifted degree-4 module term cannot be supplied by a pure degree-4 row, blocking the direct generator-degree leading-term/unit-monomial cover shortcut.
degree4_pure_term_obstruction.scope: Higher-degree polynomial combinations and S-polynomials are not excluded. This does not decide Stage B, Stage C, or projective support.

unit_minor_boundary.statement: Every 7 by 7 maximal minor has homogeneous degree 4+6*3=22, so no maximal minor is a nonzero constant unit in the unlocalized polynomial ring.
unit_minor_boundary.scope: A chartwise unit after normalization or localization is not excluded.

safe_schur_complement.notation: Write M=[u|A], with u=P4 and A=P3. For six rows I put Delta_I=det(A_I).
safe_schur_complement.exact_identity: det(M_{I union {a}})=sigma_{I,a}, with the rows ordered as I followed by a.
safe_schur_complement.rank_test_on_chart: On D(Delta_I), rank(M)=7 iff at least one sigma_{I,a} is nonzero.
finite_global_route: First certify that finitely many Delta_I cover P^36, equivalently that A=P3 has rank 6 at every projective q.

Then, for every chosen chart D(Delta_I), certify that the simultaneous sigma_{I,a}=0 locus is empty there, for example by proving a power of Delta_I lies in the ideal generated by the sigma numerators.
safe_schur_complement.blocking_gate: The first step is exactly the unresolved global Stage-B six-minor cover. Schur compression is safe after that gate but cannot bypass it.
safe_schur_complement.coordinate_plane_progress: The 412-row certificate supplies this cover only on the union q-support at most 3; it has rank 75 on all 7770 coordinate P^2 restrictions.

constant_row_compression.principle: For a constant compression R, rank(RM)<=rank(M), so an empty rank-drop locus for RM is a decisive sufficient certificate for M. A nonempty compressed rank-drop locus is only an over-approximation and gives no point of the original locus.
constant_row_compression.maximal_minor_height_upper_bound: For an r by n matrix, ht(I_n)<=r-n+1 when the maximal-minor ideal is proper.
constant_row_compression.conclusion: A homogeneous ideal with empty projective zero locus in P^36 has radical equal to the height-37 irrelevant ideal. The determinantal height bound therefore makes r43 the smallest constant compression not ruled out for augmented rank-drop emptiness; r42 is impossible. For P3 alone, r42 is the corresponding smallest row count not ruled out. Meeting the row bound is necessary, not an existence or emptiness proof.

sharp_next_gate.gate: For the Schur-chart route, produce an exact global finite cover of P^36 by nonvanishing 6 by 6 minors of the P3 contraction matrix (Stage B), then run chartwise degree-22 Schur-numerator certificates for Stage C. A completed direct augmented-module surjectivity certificate is an alternative global route.
sharp_next_gate.preferred_certificate: A small list of six-row minors Delta_alpha together with an exact irrelevant-ideal membership m^s subset <Delta_alpha>; then, on each D(Delta_alpha), exact identities Delta_alpha^k in <sigma_{alpha,a}>.
sharp_next_gate.stop_rule: The existing 72 MB and 105 MB Singular module jobs are poor low-resource experiments in light of prior affine resource nonverdicts and the high dimension thresholds, but a completed exact run would be decisive. The dimension audit is not a runtime impossibility proof.

theorem_boundary.proves: Exact dimension obstructions to low-degree raw Macaulay surjectivity for r43, r64, and r412; an exact pure-term obstruction for those selected contraction families; and the algebraically safe Schur-complement reduction conditional on a global Stage-B minor cover.
theorem_boundary.does_not_prove: Global Stage-B or Stage-C emptiness, an irrelevant-power certificate, projective support emptiness, a modular survivor, characteristic-zero landing, transition stabilization, or the Problem E headline.
